subject: nereid-origin
q: Is the Doc Hathaway running the Lucky Hammer the same Hathaway?
detail:
Arc 6 records that THE LUCKY HAMMER THRIVES UNDER DOC HATHAWAY, and the Lucky Hammer turns up again in Arc 7 inside Evie's certification thread. Marianne Hathaway created Project Nereid and is a doctor. Whether the woman keeping a bar or a workshop running in Arc 6 is the creator of Nereid, one of her twelve daughters, or an unrelated Hathaway is not written anywhere — and the Archive is not going to decide it by surname. It is the same shape of guess as dating Specter Haven to Arc 12, which was wrong.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. YES — SHE IS DR. MARIANNE HATHAWAY. The woman who built Project Nereid runs Sera's bar. See c-hathaway-hammer. RETIRED.
